metadata.title: software-workflow-automation - Sources
metadata.description: Workflow automation platform references: n8n, Langflow, Huginn, Temporal, Trigger.dev v4, Inngest, Hatchet, Restate, DBOS, Vercel and Cloudflare Workflows, iPaaS billing, and automation governance patterns.

platforms.name: n8n Documentation
platforms.description: Primary source for n8n workflow design, nodes, credentials, governance, and hosting behavior.

platforms.name: Langflow Deployment Overview
platforms.description: Primary source for deploying Langflow flows and exposing local builds safely.

platforms.name: Langflow MCP Server
platforms.description: Primary source for using Langflow as an MCP server and exposing flow tools to coding agents.

platforms.name: Huginn Repository
platforms.description: Reference source for Huginn self-hosted automation agents, scenarios, and deployment expectations.

platforms.name: Temporal Workflows
platforms.description: Primary source for durable execution, replay, retries, and code-defined workflows.

platforms.name: Model Context Protocol (spec)
platforms.description: Canonical Model Context Protocol concepts and architecture for connecting AI applications to tools and data.

platforms.name: MCP — Build a Server
platforms.description: Official guide to building MCP servers (exposing tools/data to AI agents). Resolve current SDK and tooling at use-time.

platforms.name: Trigger.dev Idempotency
platforms.description: Primary source for idempotency design in long-running code-first background workflows.

platforms.name: Trigger.dev Migrating from v3
platforms.description: Primary source for v3-to-v4 breaking changes: SDK import path, queue predefinition, lifecycle hook signatures, self-hosting changes. v3 was fully shut down 2026-07-01.

platforms.name: n8n Community License (Sustainable Use License explainer)
platforms.description: Primary explainer for n8n's fair-code Sustainable Use License: internal business use, non-commercial redistribution, and the Enterprise License for .ee. files.

platforms.name: Hatchet Documentation
platforms.description: Primary source for Hatchet’s Postgres-backed workflow engine; verify engine/SDK generation and supported releases here.

platforms.name: n8n LICENSE.md
platforms.description: Licence text for n8n (Sustainable Use License plus n8n Enterprise License for .ee. files).

platforms.name: Temporal Worker Versioning
platforms.description: Primary source for Worker Versioning deployment routing, pinning and Server/SDK compatibility.

platforms.name: Trigger.dev Wait for Token
platforms.description: Primary source for v4 Waitpoint tokens: wait.createToken, wait.forToken, completion, and timeouts.

platforms.name: Inngest Pricing
platforms.description: Primary source for Inngest plans, execution-based billing, and plan limits (volatile).

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workflows Pricing
platforms.description: Primary source for Cloudflare Workflows billing units and limits; resolve rates at use time.

platforms.name: Vercel Workflows
platforms.description: Primary source for Vercel Workflows on the open-source Workflow SDK: directives, pricing units, and limits.

platforms.name: Restate
platforms.description: Restate durable-execution runtime repository; licensed under the Business Source License 1.1.

platforms.name: DBOS Transact (Python)
platforms.description: DBOS durable-execution library backed by Postgres; MIT licensed.

platforms.name: Activepieces
platforms.description: Open-source automation platform; core MIT with commercially licensed enterprise directories.

platforms.name: Windmill
platforms.description: Script-first workflow and internal-tool platform; AGPLv3 open-source build with proprietary enterprise features.

platforms.name: Pipedream Pricing
platforms.description: Primary source for Pipedream credit-based billing.

platforms.name: Huginn Releases
platforms.description: Huginn release history; check here for current upstream maintenance activity.

operations_and_governance.name: n8n Queue Mode
operations_and_governance.description: Primary source for n8n scaling, worker mode, and execution-concurrency operating patterns.

operations_and_governance.name: n8n Source Control and Environments
operations_and_governance.description: Primary source for n8n Git-backed environments, branch patterns, and workflow promotion between instances.

operations_and_governance.name: n8n External Secrets
operations_and_governance.description: Primary source for vault-backed credential handling, project scoping, and secrets governance in n8n.

operations_and_governance.name: PostgreSQL INSERT
operations_and_governance.description: ON CONFLICT expressions can read existing rows; atomic UPSERT is not a replay-safety guarantee.

operations_and_governance.name: PostgreSQL MERGE
operations_and_governance.description: MERGE actions use ordinary update expressions; review target-dependent updates before replay.

operations_and_governance.name: n8n Community Node Risks
operations_and_governance.description: Community nodes can access the host and workflow data; do not assume task-runner sandboxing applies.

operations_and_governance.name: Temporal Approval Pattern
operations_and_governance.description: TypeScript condition returns false on timeout; handle approval timeout explicitly.
